title: Topic 14
japanese_text: 横浜は<u>傾斜</u>のきつい道が多いが、みなとみらい駅周辺は<u>埋め立て地</u>のため<u>平たん</u>だ。美しい<u>街並み</u>が人気で、休日は大勢の人で<u>にぎわっている</u>。
english_translation: Yokohama has lots of streets with steep inclines, but the area around Minato-Mirai Station is flat because it is reclaimed land. The beautiful streetscapes have proved popular, bustling with people on weekends and holidays.
